capabilities: Render Bases results as a sortable Epic–Feature–PBI–Task tree with drag-and-drop re-parenting
Write parent, order and type frontmatter properties to notes via backfill and drag moves
Project the backlog as a kanban board, roadmap, and a separate Deliverables board
Score and rank items with a weighted value model using RICE, ICE, WSJF or value-over-effort
Track releases with status, dates, scope trees and generated release notes
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.12.0 or newer with the Bases core plugin enabled. Warns that unquoted '#' in frontmatter values will be truncated by any plugin write. Roadmap drag gestures on timeline bars are specified but not yet built.
problem: Bases only returns flat lists of notes, and Obsidian has no native way to organize work items as a ranked, draggable hierarchy with progress and planning views.

relations.evidence: inspired by the backlog in Azure DevOps Boards

summary: Bases view that turns a flat folder of notes into a sortable work-item tree of Epics, Features, PBIs and Tasks, with kanban, roadmap, estimation and release views.
